capabilities.why: Pre-execution command safety hooks inspect shell commands on the control plane before dispatching to the guest microVM, immediately halting malicious exfiltration attempts and privilege escalations.

MicroVM hardware snapshots capture guest memory and disk state before executing untrusted packages, allowing instant rollback to a clean checkpoint when step 7 crashes or encounters malicious corruption.

Strict outbound network egress policies keep the microVM isolated from external command-and-control servers, ensuring prompt-injected packages and malware payloads cannot leak sensitive secrets or environment variables.
